properties.budget_notes: Project STP capacity 85 MLD = Rajapur 60 MLD + Kodra 25 MLD. Both plants are also covered by the Rs 904 cr rehabilitation project (see Naini 80 MLD).
properties.operator_source_name: Press Network of India — Prayagraj concession agreement (Prayagraj Water Pvt. Ltd.), 11 Jan 2019
properties.operator_notes: Prayagraj One City One Operator HAM (concession agreement Jan 2019): 3 new STPs totalling 72 MLD (Naini 42, Phaphamau 14, Jhunsi 16) plus O&M of existing sewerage assets of 254 MLD for 15 years. The six existing plants in the 254 MLD set sum exactly to 254 MLD (Naini 80 + Numayadhai 50 + Rajapur 60 + Salori 29 + Kodra 25 + Ponghat 10). JJM UP lists UP Jal Nigam as the maintaining authority (wings vary by plant).
properties.om_source_name: UP Jal Nigam — Weekly Progress of Namami Gange Projects
properties.om_notes: Same shared Prayagraj rehabilitation HAM as STP-UP-073: total O&M cost Rs 845.85 cr over 15 years = Rs 56.39 cr/yr. Note the UPJN District B&E construction project covering this plant (and Kodra 25 MLD) lists O&M cost Rs 0.00 — its O&M is evidently inside the rehabilitation HAM figure, not the construction project.
properties.noncompliance_reason: Fails NGT norms on FC; Overloaded (133.4% of design) — inflow exceeds design capacity
properties.status_update: Salori STP augmentation +43 MLD (13-drain I&D, Rs 331.75 crore) counted among NMCG FY 2025-26 completions; BUT UP JJM portal (Nov 2026) still shows the same project incomplete — I&D 80.5%, rising main 94% (16 Nov 2026) — so the +43 MLD should be treated as substantially complete, not fully operational. NGT Nov 2025: 128 MLD treatment gap in Prayagraj district; 25 untapped drains to Ganga + 15 to Yamuna. Three new STPs sanctioned pre-Kumbh 2025 (Salori 43, Rasoolabad 90, Naini 50 MLD) to take city capacity to 523 MLD.
properties.effluent_notes: Untapped drains in same town (drains.csv): 27 drains, 182.7 MLD combined flow (includes stormwater; not directly comparable to sewage); Cross-check: UP JJM portal 'Operational STP Dec 2023' list gives a second Dec-2023 sampling (often worse than CPCB annex values, e.g. Bingawan BOD 45 vs 39.5, Jajmau 130 BOD 21 vs 12.1); see NOTES.md
